fields.value: Hosted view: a Postgres-backed etude view that running jobs push to

Jack Heart, 2026-11-23: "(b) in manabot, get minimal fly + neon (or similar) set up a website + a persistent postgres store (c) start testing eperiments on it". Asked where the hosted site gets its data, he chose: jobs push to it (Etude adds a server mode: Postgres holds runs and charts; running jobs send new metric blocks, state and console straight to it; the bucket stays the record; the server reads nothing back from it). Database: "either one, but be consistent" -> Neon, as kata and cadenza deploy (deploy/kata-neon.sh).

Why: `etude view experiments/ --source r2://manabot/jobs` read 1.3 GB in about 17 minutes and published no runs (307,458 keys, 108 GB under 517 names). Earlier direction (Jack Heart, 2026-11-22): "we could have the jobs do more ush to the server rather tan just requiring on pulling hte s3", "some sort of aggregation worker". "You own your own data" holds: canonical files still go to the bucket; a server outage must never hurt training.

Outcome: `etude view` can run against a Postgres URL and accept pushed observations over HTTP; a launched run given the server address pushes as it seals blocks; the pages from EXP-57 render from Postgres with subsecond graph loads. Service stack per earlier choices: psycopg 3 hand-written SQL, Alembic, relational schema. Builds on EXP-57 (stack on it). The manabot deployment is a separate Task.
